content.value: You have a circular region which passes through the fixed point: (20) A (4, -3), B (-2, 7) and C (-4, 5) for an urban plan. Formulate the problem as a system of linear equation and hence solve it by using matrix operation. Moreover using the concept of geometry, find the centre of the circle.
